derivation.rule: E = min(E_cap, floor((cap - margin - startup - 2*eval - verify_overhead) / epoch_s))
derivation.train_rate_basis: steady second-half rate x derate 0.7 (epoch average has one-time worker start-up; derate covers CPU contention variation)

budget.enforcement: timeout --kill-after=60 10229 around train+evaluate (cap minus the measured eval + verify time); SIGTERM closes the manifest as interrupted; verify then runs in a fresh process, all under nice -n 19 ionice -c3
budget.runs: one run, fresh run_id, nohup + log in the run dir; no duplicate launches
budget.second_model: only if an additional 2 h is available after the baseline wall time is measured

checkpoint_selection_policy.declared_at: before training (this file is committed before launch)
checkpoint_selection_policy.if_interrupted: the run is reported as incomplete; the last completed epoch is evaluated and labeled as such, never presented as the declared E-epoch baseline
checkpoint_selection_policy.policy: last completed epoch (epoch E) is the model

not_claimed: no leaderboard score, rank or percentile
no acquisition-domain generalization beyond this dataset

population.family_separation: 0 families and 0 identical files cross fit/valid (asserted before fit)

population.name: full_data_single_holdout
population.statement: ONE single holdout (legacy fold 1, family-level). This is NOT cross-validation, and one training seed: no seed-stability or variance claim follows from it.
population.test_set: not used for training, selection or evaluation; no Kaggle submission
population.valid: legacy fold 1: 60,000 rows / 15,000 families; 15,000 rows per kind; 20,000 per quality
